title: HtmlIns
responsibility: Renders the native ins element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlIns.attributes
inputs.description: Native ins attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlIns.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native ins element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlIns
outputs.description: The actual native ins element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
